data.title: 伊井野弥子 · 学生会室深夜的校服解带
data.description: 秀知院学生会室深夜，只有书桌上一盏复古绿罩台灯亮着。独自留下来复核司法考试材料的弥子解开了秀知院黑色水手校服的红色领巾，领口微松。她有些疲惫地揉了揉太阳穴，低双马尾垂在光洁的肩头。看到进门送来夜宵的身影，平日古板严苛的风纪委员脸颊骤然飞红，慌忙坐直身体却又忍不住流露出被关怀的满心感动。
data.action: seated at student council mahogany desk, Shuchiin black uniform with loosened red necktie, rubbing temples, looking up flustered with sweet blush as viewer enters
data.location: grand antique student council room with book-lined walls in midnight silence
data.lighting: warm focused banker desk lamp casting cozy circle of light on dark wood
data.mood: heartfelt school-night intimacy, endearing secret reliance
data.promptProse: Sitting at the executive student council desk late at night, Miko Iino loosens her uniform necktie amidst piles of law books. The desk lamp illuminates her flushed cheeks as she looks up with an adorable, flustered expression.
data.animaCaption: Miko studying at the student council desk at night with loosened necktie, looking up flustered.
